ru.title: Топ-10 по разрезу
ru.intent: Кто в первой десятке по выручке — самый частый вопрос к любым данным.
ru.pitfall: Без ORDER BY «топ» не топ: LIMIT отрежет первые попавшиеся строки.

en.title: Top 10 by any cut
en.intent: Who is in the top ten by revenue: the most common question asked of any data.
knobs: LIMIT 10 → however many rows you need
en.pitfall: Without ORDER BY a top is not a top: LIMIT just cuts off whatever came first.

sql.ru:
-- Топ-10 брендов по выручке
-- Меняйте: разрез, метрику, число строк
SELECT p.brand,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout s
JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
sql.en:
-- Top 10 brands by revenue
-- Change: the cut, the metric, the row count
SELECT p.brand,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout s
JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

python.ru:
# Топ-10 брендов по выручке
# Меняйте: разрез, метрику, число строк
df = fact_sellout.merge(
    dim_product[['product_id', 'brand']],
    on='product_id')
g = df.groupby('brand')['revenue'].sum()
result = (g.round()
           .sort_values(ascending=False)
           .head(10))
python.en:
# Top 10 brands by revenue
# Change: the cut, the metric, the row count
df = fact_sellout.merge(
    dim_product[['product_id', 'brand']],
    on='product_id')
g = df.groupby('brand')['revenue'].sum()
result = (g.round()

ru.title: Доля в общем итоге
ru.intent: Сколько это в процентах от всего — вопрос, который задают сразу после «сколько».
knobs: добавьте WHERE, чтобы считать долю внутри периода
ru.pitfall: Знаменатель обязан быть тем же срезом: с фильтром в одной части и без него в другой доли не сложатся в сто.

en.title: Share of the total
en.intent: What percentage of the whole this is: the question that follows «how much» every time.
knobs: add a WHERE clause to take the share inside a period
en.pitfall: The denominator has to be the same cut: filter one side and not the other and the shares stop adding up to a hundred.

sql.ru:
-- Выручка по каналам и доля каждого
-- Меняйте: разрез и период
SELECT c.channel,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.revenue) /
             (SELECT SUM(revenue)
              FROM fact_sellout), 1) AS pct
FROM fact_sellout s
JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY c.channel
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
sql.en:
-- Revenue by channel and each one's share
-- Change: the cut and the period
SELECT c.channel,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.revenue) /
             (SELECT SUM(revenue)
              FROM fact_sellout), 1) AS pct
FROM fact_sellout s
JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY c.channel
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

python.ru:
# Выручка по каналам и доля каждого
# Меняйте: разрез и период
df = fact_sellout.merge(
    dim_customer[['customer_id', 'channel']],
    on='customer_id')
g = df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
out = g.round().to_frame('revenue')
out['pct'] = (100 * g / g.sum()).round(1)
result = out.sort_values(
    'revenue', ascending=False)
python.en:
# Revenue by channel and each one's share

df = fact_sellout.merge(

out = g.round().to_frame('revenue')
out['pct'] = (100 * g / g.sum()).round(1)
result = out.sort_values(

ru.title: Срез за период
ru.intent: Тот же вопрос, но за квартал, месяц или любые свои даты.
ru.pitfall: Верхняя граница — строгое «меньше» от начала следующего месяца: BETWEEN по датам легко теряет последний день.

en.title: A slice of one period
en.intent: The same question, but for a quarter, a month, or any dates of your own.
en.pitfall: The upper bound is a strict «less than» the next month's start: a BETWEEN on dates loses the last day all too easily.

sql.ru:
-- Выручка по категориям за квартал
-- Меняйте: границы периода и разрез
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout s
JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
WHERE s.week_start >= '2026-01-01'
  AND s.week_start < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
sql.en:
-- Revenue by category for one quarter
-- Change: the period bounds and the cut
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout s
JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
WHERE s.week_start >= '2026-01-01'
  AND s.week_start < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

python.ru:

s = fact_sellout
period = ((s['week_start'] >= '2026-01-01') &

df = s[period].merge(

ru.title: Топ внутри каждой группы
ru.intent: Не общий топ, а свои лидеры в каждом дивизионе, канале или регионе.
ru.pitfall: Обычный LIMIT здесь не работает: он режет весь список разом, а не каждую группу по отдельности.

en.title: Top inside each group
en.intent: Not one overall top, but the leaders inside every division, channel, or region.
en.pitfall: A plain LIMIT does not do this: it cuts the whole list at once instead of each group on its own.

sql.ru:
-- Топ-3 товара внутри дивизиона
-- Меняйте: N в rn <= 3 и сам разрез
WITH t AS (
  SELECT p.division, p.product_name,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout s
  JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
  GROUP BY p.division, p.product_name)
SELECT division, product_name,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue
FROM (SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY division
        ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
      FROM t)
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY division, revenue DESC;
sql.en:
-- Top 3 products inside each division
-- Change: N in rn <= 3, and the cut itself
WITH t AS (
  SELECT p.division, p.product_name,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout s
  JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
  GROUP BY p.division, p.product_name)
SELECT division, product_name,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue
FROM (SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY division
        ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
      FROM t)
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY division, revenue DESC;

python.ru:
# Топ-3 товара внутри дивизиона
# Меняйте: N в head(3) и сам разрез
df = fact_sellout.merge(
    dim_product[['product_id', 'division',
                 'product_name']],
    on='product_id')
g = df.groupby(
    ['division', 'product_name'],
    as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
g = g.sort_values(['division', 'revenue'],
                  ascending=[True, False])
top = g.groupby('division').head(3).copy()
top['revenue'] = top['revenue'].round()
result = top.reset_index(drop=True)
python.en:
# Top 3 products inside each division
# Change: N in head(3), and the cut itself

    dim_product[['product_id', 'division',
                 'product_name']],
    on='product_id')
g = df.groupby(
    ['division', 'product_name'],
    as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
g = g.sort_values(['division', 'revenue'],
                  ascending=[True, False])
top = g.groupby('division').head(3).copy()
top['revenue'] = top['revenue'].round()
result = top.reset_index(drop=True)

ru.title: Помесячная динамика
ru.intent: Ряд по месяцам — основа любого разговора о росте и падении.
ru.pitfall: Месяц вырезается из строки даты, потому что week_start — текст: с датой другого формата срез поедет.

en.title: Month by month
en.intent: A monthly series is the ground for any conversation about growth and decline.
knobs: add a cut to the GROUP BY
en.pitfall: The month is cut out of the date string because week_start is text: a date in another format shifts the slice.

sql.ru:
-- Выручка по месяцам
-- Меняйте: шаг (7 знаков — месяц, 4 — год)
SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
sql.en:
-- Revenue by month
-- Change the step: 7 chars month, 4 year
SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

python.ru:
# Выручка по месяцам
# Меняйте: шаг среза str[:7] или str[:4]
s = fact_sellout.copy()
s['month'] = s['week_start'].str[:7]
g = s.groupby('month',
              as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].round()
result = g.sort_values('month')
python.en:
# Revenue by month
# Change the slice step: str[:7] or str[:4]
s = fact_sellout.copy()
s['month'] = s['week_start'].str[:7]
g = s.groupby('month',
              as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
g['revenue'] = g['revenue'].round()

ru.title: Скользящее среднее
ru.intent: Сглаживает шум месяца и показывает, куда ряд идёт на самом деле.
knobs: смените месяц на неделю, чтобы сгладить мельче
ru.pitfall: Первые месяцы усредняются по неполному окну — это не ошибка, но сравнивать их с остальными нельзя.

en.title: Rolling average
en.intent: Smooths the noise of a single month and shows where the series actually goes.
knobs: switch month to week for finer smoothing
en.pitfall: The first months average over a partial window: not an error, but not comparable to the rest either.

sql.ru:
-- Помесячный ряд и среднее за три месяца
-- Меняйте: ширину окна в PRECEDING
WITH m AS (
  SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout
  GROUP BY month)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (
         ORDER BY month
         ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING
              AND CURRENT ROW)) AS avg3
FROM m
ORDER BY month;
sql.en:
-- Monthly series and a three month average
-- Change: the window width in PRECEDING
WITH m AS (
  SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout
  GROUP BY month)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue) OVER (
         ORDER BY month
         ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING
              AND CURRENT ROW)) AS avg3
FROM m
ORDER BY month;

python.ru:
# Помесячный ряд и среднее за три месяца
# Меняйте: ширину окна в rolling(3)
s = fact_sellout.copy()
s['month'] = s['week_start'].str[:7]
m = s.groupby('month',
              as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
m = m.sort_values('month')
m['avg3'] = (m['revenue']
             .rolling(3, min_periods=1)
             .mean().round())
m['revenue'] = m['revenue'].round()
result = m
python.en:
# Monthly series and a three month average

s = fact_sellout.copy()

m['revenue'] = m['revenue'].round()
result = m

ru.title: Месяц к месяцу, в процентах
ru.intent: Насколько выросли или упали против прошлого месяца.
knobs: PARTITION BY брендом — свой ряд у каждого
ru.pitfall: У первой строки предыдущей нет, и процент там пустой: делить не на что, а не «ноль роста».

en.title: Month over month, in percent
en.intent: How far up or down against the month before.
knobs: LAG(revenue) → LAG(revenue, 12) for a year back
PARTITION BY brand gives each its own series
en.pitfall: The first row has nothing before it, so its percent is empty: there is nothing to divide by, which is not «zero growth».

sql.ru:
-- Прирост к прошлому месяцу
-- Меняйте: 12 в LAG — сравнение с годом назад
WITH m AS (
  SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout
  GROUP BY month)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 *
         (revenue - LAG(revenue)
            OVER (ORDER BY month))
         / LAG(revenue)
             OVER (ORDER BY month),
         1) AS mom_pct
FROM m
ORDER BY month;
sql.en:
-- Growth against the previous month
-- Change: 12 in LAG compares with a year back
WITH m AS (
  SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout
  GROUP BY month)
SELECT month,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 *
         (revenue - LAG(revenue)
            OVER (ORDER BY month))
         / LAG(revenue)
             OVER (ORDER BY month),
         1) AS mom_pct
FROM m
ORDER BY month;

python.ru:
# Прирост к прошлому месяцу
# Меняйте: periods=12 — сравнение с годом назад
s = fact_sellout.copy()
s['month'] = s['week_start'].str[:7]
m = s.groupby('month',
              as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
m = m.sort_values('month')
m['mom_pct'] = (100 * m['revenue']
                .pct_change(periods=1)).round(1)
m['revenue'] = m['revenue'].round()
result = m
python.en:
# Growth against the previous month
# Change: periods=12 compares with a year back

ru.title: Два года рядом, по месяцам
ru.intent: Сезонность видна только так: январь против января, а не против декабря.
knobs: добавьте разрез, чтобы сравнить по брендам
ru.pitfall: 2026 год в данных неполный, до июня: сравнивать его итог с целым годом нельзя.

en.title: Two years side by side, by month
en.intent: Seasonality shows up only this way: January against January, not against December.
knobs: the years in CASE: any of 2024, 2025, 2026
add a cut to compare brands
en.pitfall: The year 2026 is partial in this data, through June: its total cannot be set against a full year.

sql.ru:
-- Месяц 2024 против того же месяца 2025
-- Меняйте: годы в CASE
SELECT substr(week_start, 6, 2) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE
         WHEN substr(week_start, 1, 4) = '2024'
         THEN revenue END)) AS y2024,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE
         WHEN substr(week_start, 1, 4) = '2025'
         THEN revenue END)) AS y2025
FROM fact_sellout
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
sql.en:
-- A 2024 month against the same 2025 month
-- Change: the years in CASE
SELECT substr(week_start, 6, 2) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE
         WHEN substr(week_start, 1, 4) = '2024'
         THEN revenue END)) AS y2024,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE
         WHEN substr(week_start, 1, 4) = '2025'
         THEN revenue END)) AS y2025
FROM fact_sellout
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

python.ru:
# Месяц 2024 против того же месяца 2025
# Меняйте: годы в списке years
s = fact_sellout.copy()
s['year'] = s['week_start'].str[:4]
s['month'] = s['week_start'].str[5:7]
years = ['2024', '2025']
p = s[s['year'].isin(years)].pivot_table(
    index='month', columns='year',
    values='revenue', aggfunc='sum')
p = p.round()
p.columns = ['y' + c for c in p.columns]
result = p.sort_index()
python.en:
# A 2024 month against the same 2025 month
# Change: the years in the years list
s = fact_sellout.copy()

p = s[s['year'].isin(years)].pivot_table(

ru.title: План и факт на одной гранулярности
ru.intent: Сравнить две таблицы можно только после того, как обе сведены к одному ключу.
knobs: добавьте WHERE по месяцу, чтобы взять один
ru.pitfall: Соединять факт с планом до агрегации нельзя: план размножится по каждой строке продаж и вырастет в разы.

en.title: Plan against fact at one grain
en.intent: Two tables can be compared only once both are reduced to the same key.
knobs: the comparison key: month and division
add a WHERE on month to take a single one
en.pitfall: Joining fact to plan before aggregating fans the plan out across every sales row and inflates it several times over.

sql.ru:
-- План и факт по месяцам и дивизионам
-- Меняйте: ключ сравнения и период
WITH fact AS (
  SELECT substr(s.week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         p.division,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout s
  JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
  GROUP BY month, p.division),
plan AS (
  SELECT substr(month_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         division,
         SUM(target_revenue) AS target
  FROM fact_target
  GROUP BY month, division)
SELECT f.month, f.division,
       ROUND(p.target) AS target,
       ROUND(f.revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * f.revenue / p.target,
             1) AS pct
FROM fact f
JOIN plan p ON p.month = f.month
           AND p.division = f.division
ORDER BY f.month, f.division;
sql.en:
-- Plan and fact by month and division
-- Change: the comparison key and the period
WITH fact AS (
  SELECT substr(s.week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         p.division,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout s
  JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id)
  GROUP BY month, p.division),
plan AS (
  SELECT substr(month_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         division,
         SUM(target_revenue) AS target
  FROM fact_target
  GROUP BY month, division)
SELECT f.month, f.division,
       ROUND(p.target) AS target,
       ROUND(f.revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * f.revenue / p.target,
             1) AS pct
FROM fact f
JOIN plan p ON p.month = f.month
           AND p.division = f.division
ORDER BY f.month, f.division;

python.ru:
# План и факт по месяцам и дивизионам

s = fact_sellout.merge(
    dim_product[['product_id', 'division']],
    on='product_id')
s['month'] = s['week_start'].str[:7]
fact = s.groupby(

    as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

ru.title: Против среднего по своей группе
ru.intent: Сравнивать клиента со средним по всей базе нечестно: у каналов разный масштаб.
ru.pitfall: Среднее считается по группе, а не по всей таблице: без PARTITION BY аптека сравнивается с сетью.

en.title: Against the average of its own group
en.intent: Comparing a customer with the average of the whole base is unfair: channels differ in scale.
knobs: LIMIT 15 → the length of the list
en.pitfall: The average is taken over the group, not the whole table: without PARTITION BY a pharmacy is measured against a chain.

sql.ru:
-- Насколько клиент выше среднего в канале
-- Меняйте: разрез в PARTITION BY
WITH c AS (
  SELECT cu.channel, cu.customer_name,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout s
  JOIN dim_customer cu USING (customer_id)
  GROUP BY cu.channel, cu.customer_name)
SELECT channel, customer_name,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(revenue - AVG(revenue) OVER (
         PARTITION BY channel)) AS vs_avg
FROM c
ORDER BY vs_avg DESC
LIMIT 15;
sql.en:
-- How far above its channel average
-- Change: the cut in PARTITION BY
WITH c AS (
  SELECT cu.channel, cu.customer_name,
         SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue
  FROM fact_sellout s
  JOIN dim_customer cu USING (customer_id)
  GROUP BY cu.channel, cu.customer_name)
SELECT channel, customer_name,
       ROUND(revenue) AS revenue,
       ROUND(revenue - AVG(revenue) OVER (
         PARTITION BY channel)) AS vs_avg
FROM c
ORDER BY vs_avg DESC
LIMIT 15;

    ['channel', 'customer_name'],

c['vs_avg'] = (c['revenue']
               - avg.transform('mean')).round()
c['revenue'] = c['revenue'].round()
result = c.sort_values(
    'vs_avg', ascending=False).head(15)

ru.title: Факт с названиями вместо кодов
ru.intent: Заготовка, с которой начинается почти любой разбор: цифры плюс имена.
ru.pitfall: Каждый join к справочнику безопасен, только пока ключ в нём уникален: иначе строки размножатся.

en.title: Facts with names instead of codes
en.intent: The starting point of almost any analysis: numbers plus the names behind them.
knobs: drop the lookups you do not need
LIMIT 20 → how many rows to look at
en.pitfall: Each join to a lookup is safe only while its key is unique there; otherwise the rows fan out.

JOIN dim_region r USING (region_id)
ORDER BY s.week_start DESC, s.revenue DESC
LIMIT 20;

ru.title: LEFT, чтобы не потерять строки без пары
ru.intent: Продажи вне промо — это большинство строк, и обычный JOIN выбрасывает их молча.
knobs: LEFT JOIN → JOIN, чтобы увидеть потерю
ru.pitfall: У строк без пары все колонки справочника пустые: считать по ним без COALESCE значит потерять целую группу.

en.title: LEFT so unmatched rows survive
en.intent: Sales outside promo are most of the rows, and a plain JOIN drops them without a word.
knobs: LEFT JOIN → JOIN to watch the loss
en.pitfall: For unmatched rows every lookup column is empty: counting on them without COALESCE loses a whole group.

sql.ru:
-- Продажи с промо и без него
-- Меняйте: LEFT на обычный JOIN и сравните
SELECT COALESCE(m.mechanic, '-') AS mechanic,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout s
LEFT JOIN dim_promo m USING (promo_id)
GROUP BY mechanic
ORDER BY revenue DESC;
sql.en:
-- Sales with and without a promo
-- Change LEFT to a plain JOIN and compare
SELECT COALESCE(m.mechanic, '-') AS mechanic,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(s.revenue)) AS revenue
FROM fact_sellout s
LEFT JOIN dim_promo m USING (promo_id)
GROUP BY mechanic
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

ru.title: Два факта в одном отчёте
ru.intent: Продажи и остатки лежат в разных таблицах с разной гранулярностью, и это главная ловушка.
knobs: добавьте product_id в обе части, чтобы считать по товару
ru.pitfall: Сначала каждую таблицу сводим к общему ключу, и только потом соединяем: иначе недельные строки размножат месячные.

en.title: Two fact tables in one report
en.intent: Sales and stock live in different tables at different grains, and that is the main trap.
knobs: add product_id to both sides to work per product
en.pitfall: Reduce each table to the shared key first and join after: otherwise the weekly rows fan the monthly ones out.

sql.ru:
-- Продажи и остатки по месяцам
-- Меняйте: ключ соединения и метрики
WITH sell AS (
  SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(units) AS sold
  FROM fact_sellout
  GROUP BY month),
stock AS (
  SELECT substr(month_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(units_on_hand) AS on_hand
  FROM fact_stock
  GROUP BY month)
SELECT s.month, s.sold, k.on_hand,
       ROUND(1.0 * k.on_hand / s.sold,
             2) AS stock_ratio
FROM sell s
JOIN stock k USING (month)
ORDER BY s.month;
sql.en:
-- Sales and stock by month
-- Change: the join key and the metrics
WITH sell AS (
  SELECT substr(week_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(units) AS sold
  FROM fact_sellout
  GROUP BY month),
stock AS (
  SELECT substr(month_start, 1, 7) AS month,
         SUM(units_on_hand) AS on_hand
  FROM fact_stock
  GROUP BY month)
SELECT s.month, s.sold, k.on_hand,
       ROUND(1.0 * k.on_hand / s.sold,
             2) AS stock_ratio
FROM sell s
JOIN stock k USING (month)
ORDER BY s.month;

python.ru:
# Продажи и остатки по месяцам
# Меняйте: ключ соединения и метрики
a = fact_sellout.copy()
a['month'] = a['week_start'].str[:7]
sell = a.groupby('month',
                 as_index=False)['units'].sum()
sell = sell.rename(columns={'units': 'sold'})
b = fact_stock.copy()
b['month'] = b['month_start'].str[:7]
stock = b.groupby(
    'month',
    as_index=False)['units_on_hand'].sum()
stock = stock.rename(
    columns={'units_on_hand': 'on_hand'})
m = sell.merge(stock, on='month')
m['stock_ratio'] = (m['on_hand']
                    / m['sold']).round(2)
result = m.sort_values('month')

ru.title: Дубли по ключу
ru.intent: Первое, что проверяют в чужой выгрузке: не задвоились ли строки.
knobs: набор колонок в GROUP BY — это и есть ключ
ru.pitfall: Дубль определяется ключом, а не строкой целиком: с другим набором колонок ответ будет другим.

en.title: Duplicates by key
en.intent: The first thing to check in someone else's export: whether rows are doubled.
knobs: the columns in GROUP BY are the key
drop the LIMIT to see all of them
en.pitfall: A duplicate is defined by the key, not by the whole row: a different set of columns gives a different answer.

sql.ru:
-- Ключи, которые встречаются не по разу
-- Меняйте: набор колонок ключа
SELECT sale_date, customer_name, sku_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM staging_raw_sellout
GROUP BY sale_date, customer_name, sku_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY n DESC, sale_date
LIMIT 20;
sql.en:
-- Keys that occur more than once
-- Change: the set of key columns
SELECT sale_date, customer_name, sku_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM staging_raw_sellout
GROUP BY sale_date, customer_name, sku_code
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY n DESC, sale_date
LIMIT 20;

ru.title: Сколько пустых в каждой колонке
ru.intent: Пропуски решают, каким метрикам по этой выгрузке вообще можно верить.
ru.pitfall: COUNT(колонка) не считает пустые, а COUNT(*) считает все строки: разница между ними и есть пропуски.

en.title: How many blanks in each column

knobs: COUNT(*) - COUNT(col) gives the blank count
en.pitfall: COUNT(column) skips blanks while COUNT(*) counts every row: the gap between them is the missing data.

       COUNT(revenue) AS revenue
FROM staging_raw_sellout;

ru.title: Число, записанное текстом
ru.intent: В выгрузке сумма приходит с запятой вместо точки, и SUM по ней врёт молча.
knobs: добавьте свои колонки в ту же проверку
ru.pitfall: Пустые значения после приведения становятся пустыми, а не нулями, и в сумму не попадают вовсе.

en.title: A number stored as text
en.intent: The export writes amounts with a comma instead of a dot, and SUM over them lies without a word.
knobs: add your own columns to the same check
en.pitfall: Blanks stay blank after the conversion rather than becoming zeros, so they never reach the sum.

sql.ru:
-- Сумма читается только после чистки
-- Меняйте: символ в REPLACE
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN revenue LIKE '%,%'
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_comma,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(revenue, ',', '.')
                 AS REAL))) AS revenue_clean
FROM staging_raw_sellout;
sql.en:
-- The sum only reads after cleaning
-- Change: the character in REPLACE
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_all,
       SUM(CASE WHEN revenue LIKE '%,%'
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_comma,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(revenue, ',', '.')
                 AS REAL))) AS revenue_clean
FROM staging_raw_sellout;

python.ru:
# Сумма читается только после чистки
# Меняйте: символ в str.replace
raw = staging_raw_sellout['revenue']
text = raw.fillna('').astype(str)
clean = pd.to_numeric(
    text.str.replace(',', '.'),
    errors='coerce')
result = pd.DataFrame([{
    'rows_all': len(raw),
    'with_comma': int(
        text.str.contains(',').sum()),
    'revenue_clean': round(clean.sum())}])
